deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematical derivation. It is the second page of a protocol, or list of sessions, of the Göttingen mathematical-physical seminar (Weber's physical exercises) for the summer semester 1851. It continues the previous page, which runs from 1 May to 26 June and assigns the student talks.

Sessions recorded here:
- 3 July: barometric measurement of the height of the Kleper, a hill near Göttingen.
- 10 July:
  - report on the barometric height measurement of 3 July;
  - experiments on vulcanised rubber. They test how the ratio stress/strain, which equals the extension (Young's) modulus for infinitesimal strains, changes with finite extension. In modern terms this is nonlinear elasticity of rubber.
  - Ritter's talk on transverse vibrations of stretched strings (assigned 19 June).
- 17 July: determination of Young's modulus from the bending of a rod, with the deflection read by mirror and scale (Poggendorff–Gauss method).
- 24 July:
  - experiment on the rate of cooling with a bimetallic-strip thermometer (two different metal strips soldered lengthwise), its curvature measured by the mirror-and-scale method of 17 July;
  - Krüger's talk (topic assigned 19 June: reliability and corrections of the Mendelssohn balance).
- 31 July: on the occasion of the solar eclipse of 28 July 1851 (a total eclipse visible in Scandinavia and East Prussia), a discussion of physical questions raised by recent observations of total solar eclipses.
  - The same session has a talk by Riemann (assigned 19 June: determination of the constants of the bifilar magnetometer after Gauss, Resultate aus den Beobachtungen des magnetischen Vereins 1840).
  - The pencil note in the right margin restates the eclipse topic as a talk title: 'Über einige durch die neueren Beobachtungen totaler Sonnenfinsternisse angeregten physischen Fragen (aus Anlass der Sonnenfinsterniss vom 28. Juli). Vortrag'. Because the line 'Vortrag von Riemann. S. 19 Juni' points back to the 19 June assignment (the bifilar magnetometer), the eclipse discussion is a separate item. It is not necessarily Riemann's own talk, though the marginal 'Vortrag' leaves open that someone, possibly Riemann, drafted it as a lecture.
- 7 August: Ritter's talk on longitudinal and torsional vibrations of stretched strings.

There is nothing to reconstruct mathematically. The page is an administrative record useful for Riemann's biography: his participation in Weber's seminar in 1851 and his assigned talk on Gauss's bifilar magnetometer.

deep.surprise_reason: Purely an administrative seminar protocol with no mathematics. Riemann's membership in Weber's mathematical-physical seminar around 1850–51 is known. The only minor point of interest is the explicit record of his assigned talk (Gauss's bifilar magnetometer) and the eclipse discussion of 31 July 1851.
transcription_corrections: 'Kleper' is correct: it is a hill near Göttingen (cf. Kleperweg), not a misreading.
'Beugung eines Stabes' is as written in the manuscript; it means 'Biegung' (bending).

In the 31 July entry the manuscript has 'Beob-achtungen' followed by struck-out 'physischer Fragen', as transcribed. The pencil margin reads 'angeregten physischen Fragen', matching the transcription.
In 'Vortrag von Krüger. S. 19. Juni.' the stray dot after 19 is present but is merely punctuation.
